name.value: Great Estates Okanagan – Cellar Door & More

description.value: Jackson-Triggs Okanagan Estate is a well-known Canadian winery with a cellar door tasting room and retail shop in Oliver, at the heart of South Okanagan wine country. The estate offers tastings of its award-winning VQA wines and participates in local wine club programs alongside partner brands Inniskillin, See Ya Later Ranch, and Sumac Ridge. Oliver sits on a popular cycling corridor through the Okanagan, making this a recognizable stop for wine-touring cyclists.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website contact page confirms the Okanagan Estate at 7857 Tucelnuit Drive, Oliver, BC V0H1T2 with local phone 250-498-4500, matching OSM. However, the contact page lists the Okanagan estate email as info@cellardoorandmore.com, not the OSM value OkanaganEstate@jacksontriggswinery.com, indicating a discrepancy. No bike parking, washroom, water, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content; wine retail (takeout) is implied by the shop tag and the website's shop functionality.
concerns: OSM alt_name is 'Inniskillin', which is a distinct winery brand; tagging it as an alt_name for Jackson-Triggs is likely an OSM error and could cause confusion.
Email discrepancy: OSM lists OkanaganEstate@jacksontriggswinery.com but the website contact page gives info@cellardoorandmore.com for the Okanagan Estate.
Website homepage primarily promotes the Niagara-on-the-Lake estate; Okanagan Estate details are only confirmed via the contact subpage.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Okanagan Estate is a legitimate, operating winery on a popular cycling route in Oliver, BC, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website. A site visit or direct contact would be needed to verify minimum eligibility before including.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Okanagan Estate operates under the 'Cellar Door & More' branding at this location per the website contact page.

wow_evidence: well-known Canadian winery with a cellar door tasting room and retail shop in Oliver, at the heart of South Okanagan wine country
